description: Budget for the served component bundle, GET /JellyfinEnhanced/bundle.js (Features/Platform/Services/ClientScriptBundle.cs), as an identity (uncompressed) body. rawBytes: its length. gzipBytes: its length after gzip at level 9 (zlib level 9; `gzip -9 -n`, .NET CompressionLevel.SmallestSize). Checked by tests/backend/Api/BundleBudgetTests.cs (gate T) and `scripts/restructure-gates.sh size`. It is a ratchet: lowering a limit needs no reason; a history entry that raises either limit must give one. `limits` is always the last history entry's.

history.reason: First budget: the K1 bundle (minified twins, one shared featureContext) plus 5% headroom. Before K1 the bundle was 4,432,976 raw / 858,366 gzip-9 bytes.

Lowered: 24 stateless modules that several component scripts inlined now ship once from their first user (client/shared-modules.json), plus 5% headroom. K1 measured 2,640,436 raw / 677,849 gzip-9 bytes.
